description: Angular component for a signal strength widget, rendering SVG graphics and handling data updates, user interactions, and responsive resizing.

classes.name: SignalStrengthWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a signal strength indicator with SVG graphics, data handling, and responsive layout.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component settings, styles, and state variables.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Triggers SVG drawing after view initialization if pending.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Sets border radius style and triggers SVG drawing.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Processes incoming data, updates signal strength, tooltip, and visual rendering.

methods.name: drawSvg
methods.description: Creates SVG elements for signal bars and sets up resize observer.

methods.name: renderValues
methods.description: Updates SVG bar colors based on signal strength.

methods.name: renderCenterText
methods.description: Displays center text in SVG, such as 'N/A' or 'No Signal'.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Adjusts SVG scale and tooltip size based on container dimensions.
